Application Data.NAME: SecureWindows Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SecureWindows Inc. specializes in the professional installation and sales of residential doors and windows, emphasizing high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. Our team consists of trained and certified installers who adhere to industry safety standards and procedures. We manage subcontractor engagements strictly, ensuring all subcontractors are licensed and insured. Additionally, we prioritize environmentally safe practices and comply with regulations prohibiting the installation of lead-containing window treatments. Our operations include meticulous installation processes, thorough inspections, and comprehensive safety training to mitigate risks associated with faulty installations and ensure the integrity of our work.
